instruction: `template.OutJob` is the starting OutJob. Altium Designer is installed at `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`; open the supplied design there. Build a fabrication OutJob according to `C:\Users\user\Desktop\spec.yaml`. Save the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\fab.OutJob`. Requirements: In `[OutputGroup1]`, create 8 Gerber outputs that cover `TopLayer`, `MidLayer1` through `MidLayer6`, and `BottomLayer` exactly once each. Create 1 NC Drill output with `UnitsPrecision=4:3 metric` and `GerberUnit=Metric`. Create 1 IPC-2581 output with `IPC2581Revision=B`. Create 1 Pick Place output with `Columns=Designator,Comment,Layer,X,Y,Rotation`. Include exactly one `Folder Structure` output medium with `ZipOutput=True`. Keep all 11 outputs enabled and route each of them to that `Folder Structure` medium.
